summary: The guide page strictly adheres to the assigned chapter plan, word count target (2,001 words vs 2,000 target), and scope boundaries for ongoing system maintenance, improvement evaluation, frequently asked questions, and scripted demonstration preparation. Citations to ISO/IAF Auditing Practices Group guidance on reviewing, closing, and documenting nonconformities as well as NIST RPD-G-07 are accurately quoted and contextualized. Workflow decisions, inputs, roles, records, exceptions, and demonstration evaluation criteria are thoroughly detailed, supported by consistently labeled hypothetical illustrative examples without unsubstantiated vendor or customer claims.
decisions: Sample closed findings to verify objective evidence of implementation and effectiveness
Control and approve workflow configuration changes
Prioritize improvement requests (do now, schedule, wait for more evidence, or decline)
Determine migration boundaries between active findings, recent closed records, and indexed archives
Assign decision authority, permissions, and backup roles with separation of duties
Score software demonstration failure paths against objective acceptance criteria
